description: The organization lacks a continuous monitoring strategy or program to maintain ongoing awareness of information security, vulnerabilities, and threats to support organizational risk management decisions. This signal indicates the absence of processes for continuous monitoring of security controls, which is a critical requirement for maintaining FedRAMP authorization and ensuring that security posture remains effective over time.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies implementing cloud services Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAOs) conducting assessments Federal information systems requiring authorization

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Verify the existence of a documented continuous monitoring strategy Check for defined metrics that are continuously monitored (vulnerability scans, configuration assessments, etc.) Confirm that monitoring frequencies are established and followed (monthly POA&M updates, annual assessments) Review evidence of ongoing security control assessments beyond the initial authorization Validate that security status is continuously monitored through automated tools where possible Examine processes for correlation and analysis of security-related information from multiple sources Check for documented response actions based on continuous monitoring findings Verify that security status reports are submitted to FedRAMP PMO as required Confirm integration between continuous monitoring
